system.title: Design system
system.subtitle: Every token, type style and primitive in both themes
system.ruler.intro: Touch targets are 30mm, not the 44px web convention. Calibrate against a bank card, which is 85.60mm wide by international standard.
twin.canvas.label: A three dimensional model of the Dr. Ambedkar National Memorial with thirteen interactive devices
kiosk.pending: This room opens in step {step} of the build.
kiosk.loading: Opening the archive on this device
channel.entrance.about: Choose a language, take a card, and find your way through the Centre.
channel.reading.about: Search the writings and the Assembly debates, and read every passage where it was printed.
channel.provenance.about: Trace an Article of the Constitution back through the Assembly debate to the words that began it.
channel.timeline.about: A life, year by year, in documents and photographs.
channel.manuscript.about: Pages of the archive under magnification, with their transcription beside them.
channel.audio.about: Any passage, read aloud, in the language you choose.
channel.av.about: Lectures, documentaries and interviews, searchable to the second a phrase is spoken.
channel.assistant.about: Ask about the works and the Constitution. Every answer cites its page.
channel.curator.about: Ingest, correction and the state of every device in the hall.
reading.abstract.editor: Sentences chosen by an editor from this section, each with its page.
reading.abstract.machine: Sentences chosen by machine from this section, each with its page. Nothing is reworded.
reading.failed: This page could not be opened on this kiosk.

dossier.qr.title: Take it home

dossier.qr.caption: Scan with a phone. The code holds page references only, nothing about you.
dossier.onCard: Also on your card, at every kiosk you tap it.
dossier.noCard: Without a card this stays here only while you do.

entrance.take.title: Take a card
entrance.take: Take a card from the bowl and hold it to the reader. It will carry these choices to every kiosk in the hall.
entrance.ready.title: Your card is ready
entrance.ready: Every kiosk you tap it at will open in {language}. Text size: {size}.
entrance.noReader.title: No card reader here
entrance.noReader: Your choices hold at this kiosk for as long as you stay. Every kiosk has the same choices behind its language button.
entrance.leaving.title: Before you go
entrance.leaving: Passages kept on your card: {count}. Scan the code to take them home.
entrance.return: Then return the card to the bowl. Returning it erases what it held.
timeline.failed: The timeline could not be opened on this kiosk.

provenance.graph: Documents from {first} to {last}, and the links between them
provenance.hint: Touch a document to see where it came from and where it led.
provenance.count: Documents: {nodes}. Links: {edges}. Confirmed by a curator: {confirmed}.
provenance.legend.confirmed: Solid: confirmed by a named curator
provenance.title.rtc-1930: A Scheme of Political Safeguards for the Depressed Classes
provenance.title.deadlock-1945: Communal Deadlock and a Way to Solve It
provenance.method.reading: Proposed from reading the two texts side by side.
provenance.method.semantic: Proposed only because the passages are close in meaning, similarity {score}.
provenance.awaiting: A curator has not yet checked this link. Until one does, it is drawn dashed.
provenance.method.citation: The later text cites the earlier one.
manuscript.failed: The scanned page could not be opened on this kiosk.
manuscript.unread: No machine has read this page yet.
manuscript.counts: {regions} lines read. {doubted} the machine was least sure of.
manuscript.ask.nothing: Nothing was read at that spot. The machine marks only where it found writing.
manuscript.scored: On a held-out set of {passages}, this model misread {cer}% of characters and {wer}% of words.
manuscript.unscored: Nobody has measured this model against a checked transcription yet, so how often it is right is not known.
audio.engine: Read aloud by {engine}. A machine reading, not a recording of anyone.
audio.notInYourLanguage: Not yet narrated in your language. This is the passage as printed.
audio.none: Nothing is narrated in this language yet.
audio.failed: The narration on this device could not be read.
audio.empty.lead: This booth has no narration cached yet.
audio.empty.why: Narration is fetched once, from Bhashini, and stored on the device so it plays with the network off. None has been fetched for this device.
audio.recordings.none: The archive holds no recording of Dr. Ambedkar's voice. None could be traced to a source that documents where it came from, and an unverified recording in a memorial is worse than none.
assistant.lead: Ask the archive a question. Every sentence of the answer shows the page it came from.
assistant.limit: It answers only from the writings, the Assembly debates and the Constitution held here. When they do not hold an answer, it says so instead of guessing.
assistant.opener.article17: What does Article 17 of the Constitution do?
assistant.opener.outside: What did Dr. Ambedkar say about cricket?
assistant.writtenBy: Written by {engine} from the passages below, and checked against them before it was shown.
assistant.preparedBy: Prepared before the exhibition opened, from the passages below.
assistant.refusal.notInCorpus: The archive here does not answer that.
assistant.refusal.nothingFound: Nothing in the archive came close enough to that question to read.
assistant.refusal.ungrounded: An answer was written but it went beyond the passages, so it was not shown.
assistant.refusal.unavailable: This question needs the archive server, which this device cannot reach.
assistant.refusal.rateLimited: The hall has asked as many questions as it may this minute. Try again shortly.
assistant.refusal.readInstead: These are the passages the search did find. They are worth reading even though they do not answer the question.
assistant.refusal.nothingToRead: Try naming a person, an Article or a year.
assistant.loading: The archive is still opening. The questions above are ready now.
av.licence: Licensed {licence}. Reused here on those terms.
av.transcribedBy: Transcribed by {engine}. A machine reading of what was said, not a script.
av.noTranscript: This recording has no transcript yet, so it cannot be searched. It can still be watched.
av.failed: The recordings on this device could not be opened.
av.empty.lead: This room holds no recordings yet.
av.empty.why: A film is only ingested when its licence permits a transcript and its source can be traced. The archive would rather hold nothing than show a recording it cannot attribute.
